scenario.scenario_text: You are a student in a university course. You missed an important class yesterday because you were sick. Your professor sent an email asking why you were absent and reminding you that an assignment is due this Friday. Write a reply to your professor.
requirements: Ask about the missed material and the assignment

coach_content.step1_situation_ar: تخيل أنك طالب جامعي ومرضت يوم أمس فلم تستطع حضور المحاضرة. أرسل لك أستاذك إيميل يسأل عن سبب الغياب ويذكرك بواجب يجب تسليمه يوم الجمعة. مهمتك: ترد بإيميل مهذب يحقق ثلاثة أهداف رئيسية.
coach_content.step1_situation_en: You are a university student who missed an important class because you were sick. Your professor emailed you asking why, and reminded you about a Friday assignment. Reply politely.
coach_content.step1_recipient_ar: الأستاذ الجامعي (Professor) - شخص رسمي وأكبر منك مقاما. تكتب له بنبرة محترمة جدا.
coach_content.step1_tone_ar: رسمية ومحترمة (Formal). تجنب الاختصارات (don't اكتب do not). استخدم Could you بدلا من Can you.

coach_content.step4_model_email:
Dear Professor Smith,

I am writing to apologize for missing your class yesterday. I was very sick with a high fever, so I had to stay home and rest. The doctor told me not to go out for one day.

I am sorry I missed the lesson. Could you please tell me what we studied? I also want to know about the homework. When is it due, and what should I do?

Thank you for your understanding. I will work hard to catch up.

Best regards,
Ahmad
